original_target.title: Polynomial-time proper learning of univariate Gaussian mixtures
original_target.area: Statistical density estimation and unsupervised learning

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "univariate Gaussian mixtures" "proper" site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com

sources.scope: Efficient nonproper LDP learner under bounded means/variance range. Proper finite-cover projection explicitly not computationally efficient, cover size exponential in component count.

registry_checks: No Gaussian-mixture alias Palomar/Hexagon/OpenAI full metadata. Focused arXiv, Zenodo, HAL, GitHub and author searches.
scope_comparison: Original needs uniform polynomial in k and 1/epsilon, at most k output components, no parameter restrictions, in real-arithmetic sample model. LDP proper projection retains exponentially many cover members and explicit range parameters. Improper density/sampler output and fixed-k polynomial exponents do not qualify.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. October primary body is partial/different-constraint progress only.
